description: This file implements classes and methods related to Dobby container management within the WPEFramework, including container creation, destruction, status checking, and information retrieval, as well as IPC service setup and event handling.

classes.name: DobbyContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing Dobby containers, including creation, destruction, and IPC service setup.

classes.name: DobbyContainer
classes.description: Represents a Dobby container, providing methods to start, stop, and query container status and information.

methods.name: ProcessContainers::IContainerAdministrator::Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the container administrator.

methods.name: DobbyContainerAdministrator::Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container based on configuration files found in specified search paths.

methods.name: DobbyContainerAdministrator::DobbyContainerAdministrator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes IPC service and Dobby proxy.

methods.name: DobbyContainerAdministrator::DestroyContainer
methods.description: Stops and removes a container by name.

methods.name: DobbyContainer::Pid
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID of the container, parsing container info JSON if necessary.

methods.name: DobbyContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: DobbyContainer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, optionally with a timeout.
